summary: corpus-quality intake 2026-08-20: 44 apparatus chunks with verified tags, 39 dup bodies, 103 multi-model pending dupes, 1 taxonomy redundancy

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
SWEPT 2026-08-20: corpus-quality intake across 84 source texts (6068 chunks, 161 concepts, 52,599 edges). Four action items created as children:

1. d1b3db8b — APPARATUS WITH VERIFIED TAGS (critical): 44 apparatus chunks carry 234 accepted tags and 579 live edges. Hotspots: Orphic Hymns (35 chunks, 209 accepted tags, 507 edges — all Taylor Dissertation front-matter) + 9 other texts. Linked to 50438e23 for remediation coordination (apparatus removal is a re-chunk that must preserve these tags via body-matched remap).

2. d2b255b5 — DUPLICATE BODIES (high): 39 byte-identical chunk pairs, 37 in egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index + 2 in plotinus-select-works-index. All in-index crawl artifacts. Linked to 6ea7c8e0 (which tracked only 1 of 39).

3. 4ba5c250 — DUPLICATE PENDING TAGS (medium): 103 (chunk, concept) pairs pending from both Carnice-9b and Qwen3.5-27B. Legal by current index design but doubles review burden. Duplicates ticket 56d6d337.

4. 5ab28e2e — TAXONOMY REDUNDANCY (low): sefirot_tree vs sephirot_tree (0.88 similarity). Linked to 19b04fcb.

5. 53a46a8d — CONCEPT ID FORMAT MISMATCH (low/debt): 282 staged_tags concept_ids have no matching node, but ALL are rejected/reassigned — no live damage. Still a latent hazard.

False positives: the initial 47,595 'dangling curation' count was a script bug (compared against corpus files instead of DB nodes). Real dangling refs: 0. No blind/drifted tags found. No novel-cell contamination. No stuck mid-review works.
